accepted.verdict: ACCEPT. The first win strip to clear the >5% floor AND stay inside the canvas. R123's report asked for v1's gesture with v2's containment; this is it.

refused.reason: GLYPH COLLISION. The proposed mark is a LIGHTNING BOLT, which is already TURBO's glyph in this game and already appears THREE TIMES in the same interface guide (btn_turbo, btn_turbo_2, btn_turbo_3). Shipping it would put the same mark on two different controls in one list. It also does not match the live FEATURES control, which is a GRILLE (rect + three bars, FeatureMenu.svelte:196-199) and is the mark DESIGN_SYSTEM.md sanctions. The guide's job is to show the player the button they will actually see.
refused.note: The glyph is genuinely simpler and cleaner than the ornate feature_button.png badge it would replace. The objection is semantic, not aesthetic. The right fix is a capture of the live grille control, which is how every other row in this guide is produced.

refused.reason: FULL-STAGE SURROUNDS THAT BURY CONTROLS - the fence's named refusal. Measured at every plausible scale: at the live banner's own width (522px) the bar covers 72% of the reels box; at stage width (1280px) it covers hero 53%, SPIN 77%, BET 46%, BALANCE 47%, the HUD panel 78% and the reels 56%. The live banner text plate is only 522x28 at (379,488), so there is no placement that frames it without covering something.
refused.note: The bars themselves are text-free with a clear centre (3.2% opaque in the centre band) and pass the baked-text and value-safety tests. They fail on geometry alone.

refused.reason: NO PROBLEM TO SOLVE, AND A MEASURED INCUMBENT TO PROTECT. These would replace tier art that R113/R115 measured and placed deliberately so the three banner tiers read as three things rather than one growing thing, and whose contrast was already fixed (max headline 8.41 -> 11.05:1). The candidates carry far less centre light than the incumbents (strong-burst 0.0040 against burst_big's 0.1684) - safer for text, but there is no contrast failure to fix, and less presence is a presentation regression. quiet-settle is 0.1% opaque and effectively invisible.
refused.note: Refused as filler rather than as defective.

refused.reason: LIGHTING-ONLY. Mean silhouette change 0.23%, chest-band width delta 0px, XOR-vs-rest 1.33% - WEAKER than the live glance (0.34%) and an order of magnitude below every pose-changing strip. The package's own QA reports max 1.316% and a 1px chest delta, so this is not in dispute.

LIGHTING-ONLY. Mean 0.66%, chest delta 0px, XOR-vs-rest 2.13%. The feature-active window is already filled by the R122 weight-shift idle; adding a near-identical lighting loop is noise without motion.
